mprWorldOrientation.Description: Analysis of the elements’ orientation by cardinal directions relative to the room or their position on the site
mprWorldOrientation.d1: The orientation analysis for rooms is performed for windows, doors, curtain walls. The result of the analysis can be written in the room parameter or in the windows, doors, curtain walls parameter
mprWorldOrientation.d2: The orientation analysis for elements. The result of the analysis can be written in the windows, doors and curtain walls parameter
mprWorldOrientation.d3: For elements of the selected categories, the cardinal direction (considering true north orientation) is determined relative to the selected room, regardless of the element’s own orientation on the site. The analysis result can be written to the room parameter and/or to the selected elements’ parameter
mprWorldOrientation.d4: For elements of the selected categories, the orientation of the front side is determined relative to true north. The analysis results can be written to the parameter of the selected elements
mprWorldOrientation.v2: Write the result to a parameter of:
